integrity: Reproducible exhaustive exact finite enumeration, combined with a Hasse-bound universal reduction. The character-sum step is a mathematical proof; finite checker verifies only the remaining eight orders.
scientific_limitations: Three centers, odd finite fields, affine-square orbits only. Known Paley domination numbers and the earlier complete 25-element-field orbit are not claimed as original; independent priority validation has not been performed.
title: Complete affine-square orbit spectrum of three-shift quadratic-residue covers
